The implementation passes with 5/5 correctness trials and runs at 39.5 ms (vs. 48.5 ms for the reference). Two AveLang kernels do the work:

- **`matmul_kernel`**: tiled BF16 matmul (16×16×16 tiles) with shared-memory double buffering, FP32 accumulation, and fused bias addition
- **`fused_reduce_kernel`**: avgpool (kernel_size=16), GELU (tanh approximation), scale, and max reduction all fused into a single pass per batch element

A couple of AveLang-specific adjustments along the way: `al.f32` scalar kernel parameters aren't supported by the AMDGPU backend, so I used `al.constexpr` for the scale factor (since it's a compile-time constant anyway). Output dtype had to be BF16 to match the reference model under BF16 precision mode.
